newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Forekspank sees 75 mln kroon 97 profit.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Forekspank sees 75 mln kroon 97 profit.

text.p: Estonia's fifth largest commercial bank, Forekspank, on Monday said it expected a 75 million kroon profit in 1997.
The bank's 1996 profit was 46.5 million kroons and its net assets rose to 1.48 billion kroons last year.

Forekspank, quoted on the main list of the Tallinn Stock exchange, said the bank's expected profit this year would be 71.8 million kroons while its subsidiary's earnings would be 3.2 million kroons, the bank said
It said its calculations were based on expected GDP growth in Estonia this year of 3.5 to four percent and inflation of 16 to 18 percent.
Forekspank also forecast its net assets would increase by 70 percent to 2.5 billion kroons and that it expected to have an eight percent share of the banking sector.
